how_to_apply: Download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IRD website http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec.
Fill the form with complete information on educational qualifications indicating percentage of marks/division and details of work experience.
E-mail the duly filled form to Prof. Sri Harsha Kota at [email protected].
Write the advertisement No. IITD/IRD/310/2026 in the e-mail subject line.

content_sections.text: Qualification: Essential Criteria: Ph.D. candidates with expertise in air quality will only be considered. content_sections.text: Candidates without a Ph.D. with expertise in air quality will not be considered

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Salary of a selected retired/superannuated government employee will be fixed as per prevailing IRD norms. Contractual appointment with consolidated pay Subject to periodic performance review Renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier Project duration up to 31/03/2028

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies for Principal Project Scientist.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 16 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Consolidated Rs. 75,600 to Rs. 1,01,610 per month (pay slab) plus HRA @27%.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Ph.D. candidates with expertise in air quality only; preference for experience in air quality modelling using chemical transport models (CTMs) and/or machine learning based approaches.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only Indian nationals may apply.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates without a Ph.D. with expertise in air quality will not be considered.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Short-listing of eligible candidates (IIT Delhi may fix higher criteria). Online interview. IIT Delhi may fix higher criteria for short-listing than the advertised qualification. Short-listed names displayed at http://ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted with online interview details.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contractual appointment with consolidated pay. Subject to periodic performance review. Renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.answer: Department of Civil Engineering, IIT Delhi, New Delhi.
